info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Pharmacy Prescriptions Refill-v4-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Refill API facilitates the batch processing of prescription refills for patients in a pharmacy setting. This endpoint allows pharmacies to efficiently manage and submit multiple refill requests, ensuring timely medication access for patients. Typical consumers include pharmacy management systems and healthcare applications that require streamlined prescription management. The API simplifies the refill workflow, improving operational efficiency and enhancing patient care.

post.summary: Request a refill for a prescription.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to request a refill for their existing prescription. Ensure that you have the necessary prescription details before making the request.

requestBody.description: Request body for refilling a prescription. This should include all necessary details regarding the prescription that needs to be refilled, ensuring that all required fields are populated accurately to facilitate the refill process.

200.description: The refill request was processed successfully and the prescription details are returned.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the refill request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the prescription.

customer.description: Details of the customer making the request.

resource.description: Resource identifier related to the refill request.

priority.description: Priority level of the refill request (e.g., 1 for high, 2 for medium).

amount.description: Amount to be charged for the refill.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a notification upon request completion.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was made.
